{{Quote|All the above are mind-relaxing, to say the least.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab describes Tatooni Junko in his book|<ref name="GPBATG" />}}
'''Tatooni Junko''' was a beverage served by [[Chef/Legends|chefs]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] scholar [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] recommended the drink as one of his favorites in the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', which he authored in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. He suggested that his readers try the drink if they should visit any of the Huttese [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The beverage was listed with his other favorite Huttese cuisine in the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] section of his guide, which warned readers that the drink was somewhat mind-relaxing.<ref name="GPBATG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tatooni Junko was mentioned in the [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], which was written by [[Ben Burtt]] in [[2001]].<ref name="GPBATG" />
